description: This file defines the Prospect class, which models a prospect entity in a CRM system. It extends the Person class, implements EmailInterface, and contains properties and methods related to storing prospect data, building search queries, and retrieving linked entities.

classes.name: Prospect
classes.description: A class representing a prospect in the CRM, with properties for prospect details and methods for data retrieval, search, and conversion.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Prospect object by calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Populates additional list view fields, including creating proper name fields and formatting the email and name string.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Populates additional detail view fields and formats the name fields.

methods.name: build_generic_where_clause
methods.description: Builds a flexible WHERE clause for searching prospects based on a query string, matching names and phone numbers.

methods.name: converted_prospect
methods.description: Converts a prospect to a linked contact, updating relevant identifiers.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Checks if the bean implements a specified interface, such as 'ACL'.

methods.name: retrieveTargetList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of prospects for mail merge, constructing a complex SQL query based on provided parameters.

methods.name: retrieveTarget
methods.description: Retrieves a related entity based on a link ID, dynamically loading the appropriate bean class.

methods.name: get_unlinked_email_query
methods.description: Returns a query to find email addresses not linked to other entities.
